summary: Describes an envelope that binds a file to one or more time-stamp tokens obtained for it, as defined in RFC 3161 or its successors. The file does not need to be cryptographically protected, and other kinds of temporal evidence are allowed too.

eli5.summary: A date stamp proves when a paper existed. This note defines a wrapper that attaches such proofs of time to a file so they travel together.

questions: how to bind a file with a timestamp token
what is the time-stamp envelope syntax
